annotations.text: Full /map page for context: existing address search, zoom, layer toggle, home button and scale control are all untouched — only the Saved Lands panel (dashed green) is enhanced
NEW: search filter + status badges (Planted / Fallow / Multiple crops) + per-land quick actions (rename, view, add crop, delete)
NEW: inline rename — fix a rushed name without leaving the map or opening a form
NEW: optional Notes field for soil type, irrigation source, lease info
NEW: Locate-me GPS button + satellite view by default while drawing
